purpose: First product-facing HD substitution contract for one synchronized racer object.

lookup.note: The primary 16-bit presentation ID remains the lookup key. Exact composed-object guards are required because the visible 64x64 object can also depend on companion presentation, selector clipping, companion gating, palette and OAM orientation.

registration.orientation_policy: apply runtime OAM H/V flip after asset selection
registration.pivot_policy: preserve the complete object-local canvas rigidly; no independent pivot coordinate is currently proven
registration.contact_policy: no separately named wheel-contact anchor is currently proven; derived candidate preserves stock placement by whole-canvas scaling

original.scale_policy: nearest-neighbor only when a higher-density comparison surface is required

remastered_candidate.approval_status: contract-only candidate; not approved shipping art
remastered_candidate.intent: Provide a clearly provenance-labelled high-resolution substitute that preserves the source silhouette, palette, registration and transparency while exercising a non-nearest replacement path.

entries.fallback: If replacement is disabled, missing, or composition guards do not match, render the deterministic Original asset.
